## Oculis Publishes Notifications of Transactions by Persons Discharging Managerial Responsibilities


Aug 14, 2026


[PDF Version](https://investors.oculis.com/node/10331/pdf)


ZUG, Switzerland, Aug. 14, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- The attached notifications relate to the vesting and settlement of RSUs previously granted to directors of the Company.
